title: Advanced Paste: Paste with AI can't find Foundry Local models
author: jacktose
summary: Foundry Local 0.10.3 is healthy with loaded models, but PowerToys’ SDK-backed discovery returns an empty list and reports no downloaded models.

status.label: Provider compatibility design ready
status.detail: Complete service proof and current code identify the swallowed empty-list path.

next_action.label: Investigate SDK discovery compatibility
next_action.reason: Reproduce the 0.10.3 model-list call, surface failures, and define compatible model identity mapping.

judgment.rationale: The service, models, and UI failure are demonstrated well enough to investigate without more reporter data.
evidence: Foundry Local 0.10.3 reports a ready service and loaded phi-4-mini.
The model works in Foundry CLI and another model has the same result.
Refresh and service/PowerToys restarts do not help.
judgment.recommended_action: Continue compatibility and error-surfacing design; keep approval gated until exact SDK behavior and tests are established.

issue_context.summary: Advanced Paste cannot enumerate models from a functioning current Foundry Local installation.
known_information: The local service is reachable at 127.0.0.1.
The archive was rejected by automation, but the body has extensive CLI evidence.
inferences: The Foundry SDK call may throw or return data incompatible with the installed service.
Converting exceptions to an empty list makes integration failure look like no models.
issue_context.analysis: The behavior is isolated to provider discovery. Another generic ZIP would not change the next step: reproduce against 0.10.3 and distinguish errors from an empty catalog.
initial_investigation: ListCachedModels catches every exception and returns an empty collection.
FoundryLocalModelProvider passes that collection to the no-model UI state.
Closed #45340 concerned port/request handling, not discovery.
